# Orch Config

Configure Orchemax workspace, projects, agents, gateway LLMs, vault keys, and background services.

## Gateway & LLMs (127.0.0.1:8788)
- Known upstreams: `orch gateway presets` (openrouter, openai, cerebras, groq, gemini, deepseek, anthropic).
- Add upstream: `orch gateway setup --live --name <id> --url <url> --key-env <ENV>` (writes ai.yaml).
- Add key to vault: `orch gateway keys add <ENV>` (writes machine-home keys.env, mode 0o600).
- Rotation: comma-separated keys in one env (`KEY=k1,k2`) rotate on HTTP 429.
- Health / state: `orch gateway status` (PID, health, provider rotation rings).
- User-level service: `orch gateway service install [--start]` | `start` | `stop` | `restart` | `status` | `uninstall`.
  - Windows: schtasks (User). Linux: systemd --user. macOS: launchd LaunchAgent.
- Foreground: `orch gateway`.
- Connect agent: `orch gateway connect` (OpenAI-compat: `http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1` + `orch_gk_...`).

## Agents & Presets
- Detect: `orch agents scan` (writes snapshot, never alters orch.yaml) | `orch agents show`.
- Add to orch.yaml: `orch agents apply <id>...` (e.g. `orch agents apply agy openclaude`).
- Machine-wide MCP (agy): `orch guard wire --agy --scope user --allow-user-scope`.
- Open seat: `orch <preset>` (e.g. `orch agy`, `orch claude`, `orch opencode`).
- Tool auto-approval: sandboxes/worktrees are supervised. Flags (`agy --dangerously-skip-permissions`, `cursor --force --trust --approve-mcps`, `opencode run --auto`) prevent interactive confirmation prompts.

## Workspace & Projects (orch.yaml)
- Bind workspace: `orch init [--yes] [--name <name>]` (binds .orch/, seeds AGENTS.md, DEV_PRACTICES.md).
- Status: `orch status` (workspace, active sessions, locks, queue).
- Structure of `orch.yaml`:
  - `workspace.name`: string identifier.
  - `projects[]`: list of `{id, path}` (registered git repos).
  - `agents.interactive.<id>`: launch template for `orch <id>`.
  - `agents.cmds.<id>`: headless worker template.
  - `agents.auth.<id>`: `account` (plan login) or `gateway` (API-key).
  - `guard`: quality gates (encoding, ddl, litter, duplicate).
  - `budget`: `workspace_tokens_per_day`, `seat_tokens_per_day`.
